name: Shaun
description: Shaun, your desktop companion: a notch under the top bar with what your AI agents are doing, their requests to approve, a glance at what needs you, quick actions and a small chat for questions and commands, with Safe, ewe browser and your files.
author: prj786

settings.label: Who answers questions
settings.description: claude-code / codex / opencode use your own login in that app (Anthropic's rules for apps driving Claude Code are not settled). anthropic / openai / gemini / openrouter need an API key: paste it in the companion, it goes to your keyring, never here. ollama / lmstudio run on this computer. Commands work with none.

settings.label: Model
settings.description: Empty picks the provider's quick model (haiku for Claude Code, the first local model for Ollama).

settings.label: Server address
settings.description: Only for custom (any OpenAI-compatible server), or to point another provider elsewhere.

settings.label: Show on
settings.description: The primary screen, the screen you are using, or every screen.

settings.label: Show Claude plan usage
settings.description: Your 5-hour and weekly limits in the notch (Pro and Max plans; needs ewe-companion agents usage claude on).
